lines.en: label kirinsummer2archerygen:
scene kirinsummer2archerygen
I find Kirin shortly after arriving at the archery range and she immediately stops what she’s doing to come spend time with me.
lines.zh: 我到射箭场后不久就找到了 Kirin，她立刻放下手里的事来陪我。

lines.en: It’s a lot like how things were back when I would visit her at soccer practice in how easily and readily she can drop whatever she’s immersed in and just fall into me instead.
lines.zh: 这很像我以前去足球训练找她时的情形——她能那么轻易、那么干脆地放下正在沉浸的事，转而倒进我怀里。

lines.en: The issue with soccer, though, is that she never felt {i}quite{/i} immersed to begin with.
lines.zh: 不过足球那件事的问题在于，她打从一开始就{i}没真正{/i}沉浸过。

lines.en: I’m not sure if things are the same here. And chances are I {i}won’t{/i} know for quite some time as Kirin isn’t exactly the most emotionally open person I know.
lines.zh: 我不确定这里是不是也一样。而且我很可能很长一段时间都{i}不会{/i}知道，因为 Kirin 并不是我认识的人里情感最外露的那种。

lines.en: Now, if you’re talking physical openness, that’s another story entirely. And one that I’m reminded of quite frequently throughout our time together at the archery range.
lines.zh: 如果你说的是身体上的开放，那就是另一回事了。而在射箭场相处的这段时间里，我对此的体会相当频繁。

lines.en: With each and every gap between the scattered observations thrown our way by the other club members, a small hand finds its way into my lap and reminds me of how filthy it can be.
lines.zh: 每当社团其他成员抛来的零星观察之间出现空隙，就会有一只小手摸上我的大腿根，提醒我它可以有多脏。

lines.en: But all I can think of is how fragile it is.
lines.zh: 可我满脑子想的都是它有多脆弱。

lines.en: scene black
Kirin stops reaching for me after I mention something along the lines of how pretty her hands are.
lines.zh: 在我说了类似“你的手真好看”这样的话之后，Kirin 就不再伸手摸我了。

lines.en: I guess it’s harder for her to pretend to be unloved when she hears things like that.
lines.zh: 我想，听到这种话，她就很难再假装自己是个没人爱的人了。

lines.en: It’s good that things end when they do, though, as a flood of attention drifts toward us the moment Uta calls out to Kirin and beckons her to come practice.
lines.zh: 不过事情在那时结束也好，因为 Uta 一喊 Kirin 叫她过去练习，一大波注意力立刻朝我们涌来。

lines.en: If this were soccer, Kirin would remain beside me and complain about how she’s tired or doesn’t feel well.
lines.zh: 如果是足球，Kirin 会赖在我旁边，抱怨自己累了或者不舒服。

lines.en: But today she gets up.
And that might not seem like much of an improvement to you-
lines.zh: 这在你看来也许算不上什么进步——

lines.en: But, to me?
To me, it makes her feel like a new person entirely.
lines.zh: 对我来说，这让她感觉像换了一个人。

lines.en: One who can become immersed without getting lost.
lines.zh: 一个可以投入其中而不会迷失的人。

{i}Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!{/i}
